title: Forbid Mutating Git Commands in Agent Hooks
description: The IsToolBlocked function uses naive substring matching on the full command string, causing false positives. For example, `grep "git checkout" file.go` is blocked because the pattern "git checkout" appears in the grep arguments. The user reports all terminal commands are blocked in VSCode. Fix IsToolBlocked to only block when the command or a command segment actually STARTS WITH a blocked pattern (e.g., `git checkout`), not when it contains it anywhere. Also check VS Code Copilot Chat hook output format per the docs and ensure classifyTool handles VS Code tool names.
summary: Refactored hook git-command blocking to parse shell-wrapped and option-wrapped git invocations instead of relying on literal string prefixes. Agent hooks now deny mutating git commands even when invoked through env/command/sudo/shell wrappers or git global options. Extended existing blocker tests to cover those forms. Verified focused blocker and hook tests pass. A full repo/cli package run still fails for unrelated existing test issues in .devcontainer/post-attach.sh, fix/statute fixtures, SQLite schema export, and TestMonorepoTreeFullIDHierarchy timeout.
